title: Spatial proximity sequencing maps developmental dynamics in the germinal center
boundary: In-tissue antibody-oligonucleotide proximity ligation generates protein-pair reporters captured alongside mRNA on spatial transcriptomics slides. The new tissue reporter/capture interface differs from dissociated-cell Prox-seq; the protein panel itself is not the counting boundary.
evidence_scope: Published Cell2026 identity, summary, Introduction and experimental-pipeline overview accessible in primary indexed article. No complete Methods S1, oligo table or acquisition; no preprint recipe adopted.

title: SPACE-seq Enables High-Resolution Lineage Tracing in Native Tissue Contexts
boundary: DARLIN-array capture sequences are splint-ligated onto spatial pucks; the cDNA preparation feeds transcriptome and nested lineage-reporter libraries. Candidate boundary is modification of capture substrate and joint library routing; compare DART/Slide-seq precursor interfaces before counting, rather than counting a new lineage target panel.
evidence_scope: Published Cell Stem Cell2026 identity and associated-author-manuscript abstract/Results/Fig1 overview inspected. Associated manuscript is not asserted equivalent to final publication. No complete Methods/SI or acquisition.

title: Integrative spatial profiling of 3D genome organization and gene expression in tissue
boundary: Joint tissue proximity-ligation DNA and RNA libraries receive spatial barcodes; biotin-bearing cDNA is physically partitioned from DNA before different library-finishing reactions. Joint contact/RNA substrate preparation and partition are the boundary, rather than spatial resolution alone.
evidence_scope: Published Cell2026 corrected-proof identity, Results/Fig1 overview accessible in primary indexed article. Current in-press identity retained; no final-issue equivalence or full recipe/SI inspection. No draft protocols.io recipe adopted.

title: Single-molecule peptide sequencing through reverse translation of peptides into DNA
boundary: Modified Edman chemistry and antibody-mediated proximity extension convert released amino acids into DNA records linking peptide origin and position for sequencing. This is a peptide-to-DNA reporter preparation, rather than mass-spectrometry analysis software.
evidence_scope: Published Nature Biotechnology18Mar2026 identity, abstract and Fig1 overview inspected. Publisher update notice present: resolve corrected/current-body identity before full curation. No full Methods/SI or acquisition.

title: Photolabile oligonucleotides with topological light gradients enable spatially resolved single-cell transcriptomics and epigenomics
boundary: Membrane-associated photolabile oligos carry separately capturable inner/outer tags; cleavage-dependent tag retention is read through dedicated libraries alongside cellular assays. Published Extended Data1 specifies distinct inner/outer amplification and separation from endogenous cDNA, establishing a probe/library boundary beyond optical resolution alone; compare Zip-seq during curation.
evidence_scope: Published Nature Biotechnology25Sep2026 identity and primary indexed Extended Data1/2/7 inspected. Direct article open redirected to inaccessible Nature identity endpoint; indexed original overview remains readable. Full Methods/oligo workbook not inspected; superseded2025 preprint not recipe authority.

title: Bridge Capture Permits Cost-Efficient, Rapid, and Sensitive Molecular Precision Diagnostics
boundary: A separate bridge joins two target-specific probes into gap-filled circles; rolling-circle products are restriction-cleaved into monomers before indexing PCR. Multipart capture-circle formation and monomerization distinguish this preparation from ordinary MIP panels.
evidence_scope: Published Journal of Molecular Diagnostics28(1),Jan2026 identity and primary Introduction/Fig1 workflow inspected. Primary article accessible/indexed; medRxiv2024 predecessor identified but not recipe authority. No complete Methods/SI, oligo inspection or acquisition.
